audit_question: How many genuinely independent geometry/quotient pairings are available under current authority?

definitions.independent_pair: A geometry/quotient observation in which the quotient value was not itself reused as an input to generate or reconstruct the geometry being paired with it.
definitions.reconstructed_pair: A geometry/quotient association created by a governed reconstruction whose geometry-generation pipeline consumes the same weight fixture or equivalent quotient information.

quotient_point.authority: protected C04 exact representative plus WP01 canonical gauge

candidate_pairs.reason: The governed reconstruction loads one graph_weight_fixture before iterating over all five algebraic solutions; each generated geometry is therefore downstream of the same weight fixture rather than an independent observation of geometry against quotient.
candidate_pairs.permitted_use: construction consistency and obstruction analysis only; not training/identification evidence for a general geometry-to-quotient law

source_geometry_candidates.classification: source-derived geometry with unsupported quotient pairing
source_geometry_candidates.reason: The protected C06 producer audit rejects the visible source-vector Euclidean geometric weight class as a measurement of pinned C, even after all 720 boundary relabelings and both global color/complement conventions.

conclusion.statement: Current authority contains five reconstructed geometry branches over one reused quotient fixture and five source geometries with no authorized pinned-C quotient pairing. It contains no independently varied geometry/quotient observations.
conclusion.anti_interpolation_rule: No regression or interpolant fitted to these records may be promoted as a discovered general Phi:G->Q.
